blocks.text: ORION, Bataan – The Bataan chapter of the League of Municipalities of the Philippines remains opposed to the national government’s plan to rehabilitate and eventually operate the mothballed 40-year-old Bataan Nuclear Power Plant in Morong town. Orion town Mayor Antonio Raymundo, Jr., LMP Bataan Chapter president, in an interview on Thursday said the stand of the mayors’ league will remain a “no to BNPP operations.” Raymundo said the league is pointing to a resolution passed on June 8, 2023, opposing the plan to operate the mothballed plant due to “insurmountable financial cost and safety reasons.” READ: Marcos admin open to selling […]...
